area: Quantum Optics, NanoBioPhotonic Devices & Numerical Optimization
bullets: Simulated cavity-QED and multi-level quantum systems, studying photon–matter interaction, state evolution, coupling, and quantum-state control.

area: Spintronics, Quantum Transport & Nanoscale Device Modeling

Studied spin transport in graphene and ferromagnetic van der Waals heterostructure materials.
Investigated hybrid CMOS–spintronic architectures, including SPIN-FET, spin-Hall oscillators, memristive devices, and neuromorphic spintronic devices.
Mentored and supervised 20+ multidisciplinary engineering teams per semester through requirements analysis, system architecture, circuit design, simulation, prototyping, debugging, and validation.
Designed and analyzed analog, digital, RF, mixed-signal, and control circuits with emphasis on experimental validation.
Developed LabVIEW-based hardware automation and experimental measurement workflows.

Worked with signal integrity, RF/microwave circuits, filters, PLLs, ADC/DACs, op-amp circuits, transistor circuits, feedback systems, and mixed-signal electronics.
Guided hardware prototype development from schematic/layout through experimental debugging and performance validation.

organization: Foundation Sant Joan de Déu — Neuroscience Research
